note: Original first-release roster. These are authored data definitions, not an implemented game state machine. Elements share four deterministic verbs; either creature of an element can complete its project.

creatures.name: Tumbletuft
creatures.intro: Tries to slide down a flat leaf, then pretends the tumble was intentional.
creatures.friendshipAction: Nudge the loose seed beneath its leaf to make a tiny ramp; take one turn together.
creatures.quirk: Looks back to check whether you enjoyed its tumble.
creatures.memoryLine: We made the first slide together.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; a confident little bow after helping.

creatures.name: Foldfern
creatures.intro: Watches the new leaf slide, then unfolds its cape to show a surprisingly confident sliding pose.
creatures.friendshipAction: Invite it to take a turn after you try the slide; it shows its favourite pose.
creatures.quirk: Opens one leaf at a time to applaud.
creatures.memoryLine: You saved a turn for my big entrance.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; leaves spread wider during its happy pose.

creatures.name: Puddleloop
creatures.intro: Circles a floating seed, forgetting that it is already sitting in the hole in its middle.
creatures.friendshipAction: Tap the visible seed, then let Puddleloop float it to a dry pad.
creatures.quirk: Wears the last ripple like a proud little ring.
creatures.memoryLine: We found a way across the pond.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; a double bob after a successful float.

creatures.name: Siltbell
creatures.intro: Its bell gives a tiny plunk because a pebble is tucked underneath.
creatures.friendshipAction: Lift the clearly marked pebble and tap the empty bell once.
creatures.memoryLine: You helped me hear my own bell.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; a two-note ripple chime.

creatures.name: Whirli
creatures.intro: Takes an enormous breath; its tiny puff only moves one ribbon.
creatures.friendshipAction: Untie the ribbon caught on its practice pinwheel; try the pinwheel together.
creatures.quirk: Its ears spin a beat after it has stopped blowing.
creatures.memoryLine: We made the big pinwheel turn.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; a proud spin followed by a wobble.

creatures.name: Kitefin
creatures.intro: Arrives at the turning canopy and performs an unnecessarily formal mid-air bow.
creatures.friendshipAction: Accept its invitation to try the other wind direction; take turns showing off.
creatures.quirk: Offers an unnecessarily formal mid-air bow.
creatures.memoryLine: We tried the wind both ways.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; a little half turn during celebration.

creatures.name: Glintot
creatures.intro: Polishes a dark lantern, then discovers that its own belly is the light.
creatures.friendshipAction: Place the nearby lens in its marked cradle and answer its two soft chimes with two untimed taps.
creatures.quirk: Checks its reflection after every glow.
creatures.memoryLine: We lit the picnic for everyone.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; three gentle lights pulse in order.

creatures.name: Hushbulb
creatures.intro: Hides inside its petals, but a warm glow gives away the hiding place.
creatures.friendshipAction: Choose Listen at its leaf shelter; answer one small chime without a time limit.
creatures.quirk: A sneeze makes three tiny light dots escape.
creatures.memoryLine: You heard my very small hello.
creatures.growth: Amber friendship seed; petals open slightly in a happy pose.

customizationRule.note: The son invents a name, palette, quirk and interpretation of one supported ability. The chosen original roster slot becomes his custom friend; this does not add an unbudgeted ninth creature.
